fixes.explanation: Persia isn't named as the reason, friend. The LORD says, “For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen one, I call you by name…” Those are His own people, and they're the ones He names. Persia is where Cyrus sits, so I get the guess, but this call is for Jacob and Israel.

Yes, baker. The LORD says Cyrus will rebuild His city and set His exiles free, “…but not for payment or reward, says the LORD of Hosts.” Not for payment. Not for reward. Those are the two things the verse rules out.
